description: Use for the history, rules, source and proof of one index named by list_indices (GOON, LONELY, TILT, BROKE, STRAPPED, LASTCALL, OD, AIGF, SHELTER, SAD, SURRENDER, DARKWEB, PWNED, ZERODAY, BOOM, COE, ROADKILL, POTHOLE, JUNKER, LEAF, ICE, EVICTED, TAXMAN, TENTS, EBT, COYOTE, UNDERWATER, TAG, SPIN, PARLAY, KENO, BITE, DUMP, ROBOCAR, STRAY, ROCKS, FLYBY, BIGQUAKE, PPM, KPSTORM, TSA, EO, LAYOFFS, YESNO, TRENCHES, MINTS, JOBS, UNEMP, CPI, CORECPI). JOBS, UNEMP, CPI and CORECPI are monthly, from the Bureau of Labor Statistics: a day's value is the Bureau's figure now, its settlement_value is the number as first published, read by Tickerz at release, and a month loaded as history carries a note and no settlement_value. One Tickerz Index: its definition, every period in its read window with its band and signed z, the newest complete period's number as first published (first_print), the open round, past rounds, and the newest proof. latest_complete is the finished period; a provisional latest is a partial UTC day (partial_day true), and its change_pct, also given as partial_change_pct, is not a full-day change. For what is on-chain, read proof: covers_period and covers_value are the newest period of this index a proof holds and its value there, stamped_on is the UTC day that proof was stamped, with digest_sha256, bitcoin_height, proof_url (the exact text hashed, as JSON) and ots_url (the OpenTimestamps file), status (on_chain, awaiting_bitcoin, none or unavailable), and latest_complete with on_chain true or false. A live source's day is complete at 00:00 UTC and goes on-chain in the next day's proof, stamped after 12:00 UTC, so stamped_on is a day after covers_period and the newest complete day is often not on-chain yet. seal is the newest daily proof for every index: seal.day is the day it was stamped, not a period of this index. first_print is for latest_complete and stays null until a proof holds it. forecast is Forecast v1 for the next period: p10, p50 and p90 (an 80% range and its middle), the model the daily run chose, backtest (periods walked forward, coverage_80, skill_vs_last_number: the share of error removed against repeating the last number, negative when worse) and the live record; display only, never a settled number, null when none. engine is the newer forecast and surprise for the same index: period_kind, next (period, p10, p50, p90 for the next period), newest (period, value, expected p10 to p90 given before it came in, p: how often a number that far out comes in, one_in: about 1 in N, where: below, inside or above the range), record (scored, inside_80); display only, null when none. integrity is the source integrity guard: status ok, held (a number the source gave waits to be checked, and days keeps what was on file), flagged, not_checked or unknown, with held and flags. Same data as GET /api/indices/{ticker}, plus proof. Levels a source's terms keep out of the API are null.
